Send a Slack DM as Tyson Goulding from the Slack web app (NOT the Slack API/connector). Goal: delete the previous Cursor-stamped Hey and send a clean Hey that looks like Tyson typed it.

Context:
- Workspace: OptConnect
- Tyson Slack user: U093A1CD001 / tyson.goulding
- Jacob Katutu user: UAQAW9R6J
- Existing DM channel: D093RB936N6
- Direct message URL: https://optconnect.slack.com/archives/D093RB936N6
- The message to replace is Tyson's recent "Hey!" which has a "sent using Cursor" / Cursor app attribution. Message link: https://optconnect.slack.com/archives/D093RB936N6/p1787352512395049

Steps:
1. Open https://optconnect.slack.com/archives/D093RB936N6 in the box Chrome.
2. If you hit a Slack/Google/SSO login wall, STOP immediately. Report that a sign-in is needed. Do not type any password or 2FA.
3. Confirm you are in the DM with Jacob Katutu and signed in as Tyson.
4. Find the recent "Hey!" from Tyson that has Cursor attribution. Delete it (hover → more actions → Delete message → confirm). If delete is not available, report that and continue.
5. Click the message compose box at the bottom. Type exactly: Hey!
6. Send it with Enter or the send button. Do NOT use any Cursor/app compose. Do NOT add extra text.
7. Confirm the new Hey! appears as a normal Slack message from Tyson with NO "sent using Cursor" / app footer.
8. Do not message anyone else. Do not post in channels.

Report back: signed in or not; whether the old message was deleted; whether the new Hey sent; whether the new one has any Cursor stamp; the message permalink if visible.
I'll open the DM in the box browser.

Blocked by a sign-in wall — stopping as instructed.

Report:
- Signed in: NO. Navigating to https://optconnect.slack.com/archives/D093RB936N6 redirected to the Slack sign-in page ("You need to sign in to see this page." → "Sign in to optconnect.slack.com", offering "Sign in with JumpCloud" SSO or a guest account).
- Old Cursor-stamped "Hey!" message: not deleted (couldn't reach the DM).
- New "Hey!": not sent.
- Cursor stamp check / permalink: N/A.

Next step needed: a human must complete JumpCloud SSO sign-in as Tyson in the box Chrome; I did not enter any credentials or 2FA. Once signed in, the task can be retried.
